Percentage change calculator

Compare an original value with a new value and calculate the percentage increase or decrease.

Enter your values, then select the action above.

How to calculate percentage change

Subtract the original value from the new value, divide by the original value and multiply by 100. An increase from 80 to 100 is 25%.

Excel formula: =(B2-A2)/A2. Format the result as a percentage.

Important boundaries

A zero starting value has no defined percentage change. Negative starting values can produce counterintuitive signs; interpret the result in context.
